mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) increases risk of olanzapine-associated orthostatic hypotension and cardiac arrhythmias; bumetanide may increase olanzapine plasma levels through volume depletion.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, particularly potassium and magnesium; assess orthostatic vital signs; consider potassium supplementation; monitor ECG if QT prolongation risk factors present.
